Title: Greater storage capacity and performance with new Azure Disks SKUs.

Body.Content:
New Azure Managed Disks SKUs with greater storage capacity and increased performance are now available in preview. We're increasing the sizes and throughput associated with our Azure Managed Disks offerings, specifically: 

  • All existing Azure Managed Disk offerings (Premium SSD, Standard SSD and Standard HDD) will now feature 8 Tib, 16 Tib, and 32 TiB disk sizes. 

  • Premium SSD performance will now reach up to 20,000 IOPS and 750 MBps. 

  • Standard SSD and Standard HDD performance will now reach up to 2,000 IOPS and 500 MBps. 

These capabilities will allow you to significantly expand storage capacity while simplifying management and achieving better performance. We're now in preview in the West Central US region and we plan to include additional regions in the near future.

For more information please refer to our blog, or the Azure Disks FAQ.

See pricing details and more on our website.
